pages.text: [#](53341a)Fire is one of the oldest working tools in the craft, and the brazier is how you direct it. Load up to three ingredients by right-clicking, ignite it, then step back and let it burn.[#]()
pages.title: The Brazier

pages.text: [#](53341a)Most brazier workings draw power from a nearby altar, and the effect releases when the burning is complete. Patience is required — and occasionally a safe distance.[#]()
[#](53341a)Iron ingots and a stick. The brazier need not be complicated; what burns inside it often is.[#]()

[#](53341a)**Conjure Spectres** — Wormwood, Bat Wool, and Graveyard Dust. Something emerges. **Anguish of the Dead** — Tear of the Goddess, Blaze Rod, and Golden Apple. Strength radiates outward. **Deathly Veil** — Fermented Eye, Ender Pearl, and Diamond.[#]()
pages.title: Named Workings

pages.text: [#](53341a)Light passes through. **Fortification of the Corpse** — Tear of the Goddess, Diamond, and Golden Apple. Resistance for those nearby. **Graveyard Mist** — Nether Wart, Quicklime, and Blaze Powder. You will know it by the smoke.[#]()
